answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 16 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in zephyr, verified in atlas, and yarrow names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 359 aliases cost 251 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
